title: If its not that its some little bitch or other he got in with somewhere or picked up on the sly if they only knew him as well as I do yes because the day before yesterday he was scribbling something a letter
html_source:
She suspects Bloom is cheating, but she also is cheating. A bit hypocritical?
We only know for sure that he is an emotional cheater. If he is a physical cheater, Bloom is an unreliable narrator.
This parallels to the Odyssey as well because Odysseus cheats on Penelope with at least Calypso and Circe on his travels back to Ithaca.
